title: enforce-model-specific-retry-windows-and-soft-idempotency-for-streamed-function-calls
author: Maya Kline
description:
Motivation: Streaming function/tool-calls expose a difficult surface for retries: network blips, partial SSE frames, and model-side rate limits can all manifest as stream termination. Existing global Retry-After handling and global idempotency scopes were insufficient: they either under-retained idempotency for long-running streams or caused surprising duplicate tool invocations. This change introduces: 1) model-scoped retry windows: per-model default retry windows (short/medium/long) that the API surface and client SDKs can expose as hints; 2) soft idempotency for streamed function/tool-calls: an idempotency key scope that treats partial-stream terminal errors as potentially retryable within the model's retry window but requires explicit function-call acknowledgement before dedup suppression; 3) richer Retry-After semantics surfaced in HTTP headers and SSE control frames with machine-readable backoff hints and a short/long classification for model-initiated throttling.
Summary of changes (single-line checklist style):
- implement per-model retry window config and lookup on request path
- extend idempotency key semantics: add "fncall_ack" marker that clients set when a function call was executed locally (optional)
- add SSE control frame type "retry_hint" that contains "retry_window" and "retry_reason"
- normalize 429/503/504 mapping to unified error.code values and include a stable machine-readable "retryable" boolean hint
- update openai-compat adapter to translate OpenAI-style Retry-After and RateLimit headers to our new Retry-After + retry_hint mapping
- add end-to-end tests for partial-stream recovery, fncall acknowledgement scenarios, and SDK-level backoff handling
Commits:
- 3 commits: initial implementation of model retry registry and lookup; idempotency soft-scope and fncall_ack implementation; adapter + tests and docs.
Files changed (high level):
- pkg/api/handler/retry_windows.go (new registry + lookup)
- pkg/streaming/sse/control_frames.go (new frame type)
- pkg/idempotency/soft_scope.go (core semantics)
- adapters/openai/translate_rate_limits.go (mapping logic)
- sdk/js/src/retry.ts (SDK hint consumption)
- tests/e2e/stream_fncall_retry_test.go (end-to-end)
Implementation notes:
- model retry window registry is a static map with per-model defaults and optional override via route metadata. Defaults: short=5s, medium=30s, long=2m.
- idempotency: we preserve existing idempotency-key header semantics for non-streaming requests; for streaming function calls we now check a composite key: idempotency-key + stream-session-id. If fncall_ack is present (client declares it executed the tool locally), the system will treat the function call as non-retryable unless the server explicitly responds with a deterministic error. If fncall_ack is absent, server-side retries within the model retry window are allowed and recorded; when a duplicate execution is later observed, the record is reconciled and telemetry increments dedup metrics.
- SSE: retry_hint control frames are emitted prior to stream termination when the runtime detects a throttling or capacity event. Clients should consume these hints to adjust backoff and to correlate with the idempotency scope.
- openai adapter: translates X-RateLimit-Backoff, Retry-After, and OpenAI error shapes into our unified error.code + retry_hint. Backwards-compatible: existing clients that only read Retry-After header keep working.
Tests and CI:
- added unit tests for registry lookup, idempotency reconciliation, and SSE frame parsing.
- e2e test simulates transient network and model 429s to validate that client SDKs backoff and dedupe as expected.
- CI: initial run failed due to a flaky SSE test; added deterministic SSE harness and re-ran.
Review conversations and resolution (summary of threads):
- Rafael Soto (reviewer): asked for stricter semantics around fncall_ack to avoid silent duplicate side-effects. Reply: clarified that fncall_ack is an explicit client assertion; server still records execution traces and raises a high-fidelity reconcile alert if duplicates are detected.
- Ava Chen (reviewer): requested clearer SDK docs and a migration guide. Reply: added SDK examples and a migration section in docs/openai-compat/retry-and-idempotency.md.
- Ops (Jordan Lee): asked about rollout plan for Dedicated clusters. Reply: added feature flag redwood.feature.model_retry_windows gated by deployment config; rollout scheduled as a progressive enable across Dedicated pools.
Migration & rollout:
- default behavior unchanged for non-streaming requests.
- feature gated; opt-in on route metadata or by enabling global feature flag.
- docs include recommended patterns for fast-moving clients: set fncall_ack only when local side-effect completion is guaranteed.
CI status: pass after flake fix; no new long-running integration tests.
Merge: squash and merge to main on 2025-11-14.
Changelog/release note snippet: "Introduce model-scoped retry windows and soft idempotency for streamed function calls; SDKs will surface retry hints and an optional fncall_ack flag to control duplicate-tool-invocation tolerance."
Known limitations:
- this PR doesn't address cross-region eventual dedup windows for multi-region fallbacks (follow-up ticket ENG-1723).
- model defaults may need tuning per workload; we'll monitor dedup and retry-rate metrics.
Related links: Linear ENG-1284, ENG-1723 (follow-up), internal doc: /docs/operational/retry-windows.md, thread: #runtime-streaming on Slack.
